atoms: Same 62+14 ids, all gs-b-*, self-contained in art/cohort-b.svg, flat fills only, round caps. Structural changes from v1: (1) gs-b-sunhigh DELETED (no overhead sun in Book One — G1). (2) Added gs-b-rakerays: elongated upward fan (10 lines, 70u strokes, shallow -35° origin) for grand banners; gs-b-sparkline: triple-wave foam rail; gs-b-sunpath arcs for corner/epicurean compositions (plain two-endpoint curves, not full wedges); gs-b-herdband and gs-b-tidetwo repurposed as FULL-WIDTH 1200u bands for grand banners (span rule below). (3) G5 RETUNES (dusk #2A1540 removed from every B usage): gs-b-ancestor crescent sea-deep→night hollow + foam ghost-rim only; gs-b-pyre halo = foam snapped arc (no dusk); gs-b-swordfire chimney = night mass + foam smoke; gs-b-lever shadow-hand = sea-deep silhouette + foam effort arcs; gs-b-land-lastwords→gs-b-banner-lastwords palette dusk→night/deep; gs-b-land-sleepwalker→gs-b-banner-sleepwalker: dreamer on NIGHT ridge under morning rays, vermilion leapers kept, dusk dream-arcs become foam; moon-curve for p3c53/p3c33 stays night-fill-less (bare foam arc = hollow).
banner_composition_system: CANVAS 1200×340 (grand 1200×380): sky rect sea-deep #04161d; low sun LEFT (cx≈300, cy≈200, r 64-72) with full upward gs-b-rayfan + gs-b-rakerays reaching right margin; content emblem RIGHT (cx 850-950) large; horizon line full-width y≈250; flat sea bands below (sea/wave/deep thirds); 1-3 gulls upper-right; 3-6 sparks; (grand) herdband/tide bands span full width. NO centered sun (GR4: centered sun + centered emblem = half-empty sides); NO inscription lines (GR5/B-has-no-landmarks). Alternate 4 banners (field/tablets/applefall/manacle): sun RIGHT, emblem LEFT — rhythm across the 14.

grand_banners.comp: ORIGINAL 1200x380. Sun low-left r72 + rakerays spanning full width; herd band FULL-WIDTH mid (9 humps across 1200u); tide strip full-width below; masks-pair small right-inside-sea; 4 gulls; 6 sparks; horizon y=280.

ORIGINAL 1200x380. Tablets monumental RIGHT (x≈900, 320u tall); herd arc LOW full-width beneath; rakerays from low-left sun rake ACROSS the tablets (stern slant); iron = high foam contrast on deep; 2 sparks.

ORIGINAL 1200x380. Branch upper-LEFT sweeping right; apples falling across FULL 1200u width (7 apples, staggered x); seeding apple bottom-center; dusk→DEEP-sea bands (G5: autumn = vermilion apples + gold, no aubergine); 1 gull.

motif_composition_system: CANVAS 480×300 (fits ≤24rem): low sun one THIRD (left x≈140 r56, or right x≈340) + partial 5-ray fan; content emblem opposite third at 1.4-1.8× scale; horizon + narrow sea base; 1 gull + 2 sparks upper. Both thirds occupied (GR4); min feature 4px at 384px render.
shoot_symbol_policy: ALWAYS a composed 480×300 tableau symbol (gs-b-motif-<name>), NEVER the bare emblem id. Bare emblems are <g> building blocks (no viewBox); reader clones element-by-id and inherits file-root viewBox when the target lacks one — cloning a bare <g> would render the whole 1360-sheet coordinate space wrong. So every Shoot entry's symbol = its tableau (41 tableaux, listed in map sections as motif_asset).
